newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: LASTORE to list on SAfrica's JSE on Monday.
newsitem.headline: LASTORE to list on SAfrica's JSE on Monday.

text.p: LA Retail Stores Ltd (LASTORE), a specialty retailer of branded fashion and footwear, will be listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Monday through the reverse listing into the Ensign cash shell.
LASTORE said in its pre-listing statement, its listing will be transferred to the stores sector of the bourse from the cash companies sector.

It said sales, in the coming year, are expected to grow to 44 million rand from 34 million boosting profit after tax to 4.1 million rand from 2.3 million. The operating margin is forecast to increase to 13.5 percent from 10.6 percent.
LASTORE said earlier this month it planned to more than double the size of its business in South Africa in three years by increasing the number of stores to more than 55 from the current 18.
LASTORE will be 70 percent owned by the family of Abdul Peer, the chief executive. Institutions will hold 24 percent and Ensign minorities holding the remaining six percent.
